name: Nicholaston Farm Caravan and Camping
accommodation: Pitches for motorhomes, caravans, campervans and tents
beachAccess: Between Oxwich and Three Cliffs Bay; distance not stated
confirmedFeatures: Free showers, free site-wide Wi-Fi, takeaway cafe and shop, secure device charging lockers, customer fridges and freezers
overview: Nicholaston Farm is a family campsite between Oxwich and Three Cliffs Bay. It takes tents, caravans and campervans, and has free showers and Wi-Fi, an on-site cafe and shop, and fridges and freezers for guests. It is closed for the 2026 season and reopens on 15 April 2027.
surfTripFit: It's between two good beaches and has fridges and charging lockers. It's seasonal, so it only suits spring to autumn trips.
